title: Fix release workflow: crates.io dirty tree and PyPI direct-URL dependency
description: Release workflow failed for kanbus-rust/py 0.30.0 and 0.31.0. (1) rust-crate job rebuilds console assets, dirtying rust/embedded_assets/console, so cargo package/publish refuse without --allow-dirty. (2) PyPI rejects kanbus because anthus-markus is declared as a git direct URL; publish anthus-markus to PyPI and depend on it by version.
